title: Cache Service Overview
text: The cache service stores frequently accessed data in memory and falls back to object storage when cache misses happen.

title: Cache Service Overview
text: The cache service stores hot data in memory and falls back to object storage on cache misses to reduce latency.

title: Prefetch Policy
text: Prefetch is enabled for repeated sessions and can reduce p95 latency when requests share semantic similarity.

title: Rate Limits
text: The control API is rate-limited to 100 requests per minute per client token.

title: Return Policy
text: Items can be returned within 30 days after delivery when they are in resellable condition.

title: Return Policy
text: Items can be returned within 21 days after delivery when they are in resellable condition.

title: Refund Methods
text: Card purchases are refunded to the original card. Gift card purchases are refunded as store credit.

title: Exchange Rules
text: Exchanges are allowed only for active catalog SKUs and unavailable SKUs require a refund fallback.

title: Invoice Terms
text: Net payment terms are 30 days from invoice issue date for enterprise customers.

title: Discount Policy
text: Volume discounts apply from 100 seats and above with a maximum discount cap of 18 percent.

title: Credit Notes
text: Credit notes are generated only after refund approval and are linked to the original invoice id.

title: Data Retention Notice
text: Operational logs must be retained for 180 days and then archived for long-term storage.

title: Access Control
text: Privileged actions require two-factor authentication and role approval for production changes.

title: Incident Reporting
text: Security incidents must be reported within 24 hours of detection to the oversight team.

title: Object Storage Latency
text: Object storage reads are slower than in-memory reads, so metadata filters are used to avoid unnecessary lookups.

title: Semantic Cache
text: Semantic cache hit rate improves when prompts from related sessions reuse similar phrasing and intent.

title: Damaged Items
text: Damaged items are eligible for full refund including shipping if damage is verified in support workflow.

title: Shipping Charges
text: Standard shipping charges are non-refundable except for damaged or incorrect item deliveries.

title: Tax Handling
text: Refund tax treatment follows the original invoice jurisdiction and is recalculated for partial refunds.

title: Encryption Policy
text: All customer data at rest must use AES-256 encryption and key rotation every 90 days.
